title: Where Do Downloaded Files Go? A Guide for Android and iPhone
description: Can't find your downloads? See where downloaded files are saved on Android, iPhone, iPad and computer, plus how to move videos to your Gallery or Photos.
photoCaption: File locations differ on Android and iPhone.
photo2Caption: On a laptop, files go to the Downloads folder.
body:
You pressed the download button, but the video is nowhere to be found in your gallery? Don't worry, this is a very common problem. Usually the file has already been saved, it's just in a different folder than you expected. This guide explains where downloaded files are saved on Android, iPhone, iPad and computer, plus how to move them so they're easy to open.

The tips below apply to files you download through a browser, including videos, audio and photos from I Need Save. Files are sent directly from the original platform to your device and are not stored on the I Need Save server, so the only copy lives on your own phone or laptop.

Where downloads are saved on Android

On Android, files downloaded through a browser go to the Downloads folder. To open it:

  1. Open your phone's built-in file manager app. Its name varies by brand, for example My Files, Files or File Manager.
  2. Choose Downloads.
  3. Sort by newest date so your latest downloads appear at the top.
  4. Tap a file to play it, or long-press it to move, rename or share it.

There's an even quicker way: open your browser's menu and choose the downloads section. You'll see a list of the files you just saved and can open them right from there.

Why isn't the video showing in the Gallery yet?

The Gallery app sometimes needs a moment to scan new files. If the video isn't visible yet, wait a bit, then close and reopen the Gallery app. On some phones, videos from the Download folder appear in a separate album called Download or Downloads, so check your album list too.

Where downloads are saved on iPhone and iPad

On iPhone and iPad, files downloaded with Safari don't go straight into the Photos app. They're saved in the Files app, in the Downloads folder.

To watch a video from the Photos app, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Files app.
  2. Go to the Downloads folder.
  3. Tap the video you want to move so it opens.
  4. Tap the Share button.
  5. Choose Save Video.

The video will then appear in the Photos app along with your other videos. For photos the steps are similar: open the image in Files, tap Share, then choose the option to save the image.

Once the video has been saved to Photos, you can delete the copy in the Downloads folder to keep your iPhone storage free.

Where downloads are saved on a laptop or computer

On both Windows and Mac, files downloaded by your browser usually go to the Downloads folder.

  • Windows: open File Explorer, then click Downloads in the left pane.
  • Mac: open Finder, then choose Downloads in the sidebar.
  • From the browser: open the browser's downloads list. In Chrome for Windows, for example, you can press Ctrl+J.

If you've ever changed your browser settings to save files to another folder, check that folder in your browser's download settings.

Where are audio and photo files saved?

Same place as videos. Audio, whether in original quality or as a 192 kbps MP3 converted from the video, goes to the Downloads folder. The same goes for photos and thumbnails. On Android, MP3 files can usually be played from the file manager or a music app. On iPhone, audio files can be played right from the Files app.

If you'd like to know how to get the audio from a video, read our guide on how to convert social media videos to MP3.

No file at all? Check these

  • The download isn't finished. Some videos need processing first, and the button will show Preparing…. Wait until the download starts automatically and don't close the page too soon.
  • Storage is full. If your storage is nearly full, the download can fail. Free up some space and try again.
  • The content can't be downloaded. Private content, content that requires a login or region-restricted content can't be saved.

If you found the file but it won't play, check the fixes in our article on downloaded videos that won't play.

One more thing: only save content for personal use and respect creators' copyright. If you want to repost something, ask for permission first and give credit.

Frequently asked questions

Can I change where downloaded files are saved?

On a computer, most browsers let you choose the download folder in the settings menu. On a phone, this depends on the browser and system you use.

Why don't videos go straight to Photos on iPhone?

Safari saves downloads to the Files app. You need to open the video in Files, tap Share, then choose Save Video.

Are my files stored on the I Need Save server?

No. Files are streamed directly from the original platform to your device, so keep your important files safe.
